# pve_vm (Data Source)

One VM: configuration, pending changes, feature support, runtime status, cloud-init state, and guest-agent facts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_vm" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
  type = "user"
  vmid = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `type` (String) Config type. One of: `user`, `network`, `meta`.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Optional

- `feature` (String) Feature to check (e.g. snapshot, clone, copy); the feature read is skipped when unset. One of: `snapshot`, `clone`, `copy`.
- `snapname` (String) The name of the snapshot.
- `snapshot` (String) Fetch config values from given snapshot.

### Read-Only

- `agent` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/agent (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `agent_fsinfo` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_fsinfo))
- `agent_host_name` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_host_name))
- `agent_info` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_info))
- `agent_interfaces` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_interfaces))
- `agent_memory_block_info` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_memory_block_info))
- `agent_memory_blocks` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_memory_blocks))
- `agent_osinfo` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_osinfo))
- `agent_ping` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_ping))
- `agent_time` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_time))
- `agent_timezone` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_timezone))
- `agent_users` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_users))
- `agent_vcpus` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_vcpus))
- `cloudinit` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/cloudinit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloudinit))
- `cloudinit_pending` (String)
- `config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `current` (Attributes) Get current values (instead of pending values). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current))
- `feature_support` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--feature_support))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<vmid>.
- `pending` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/pending. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pending))
- `status` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--cloudinit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloudinit`

Read-Only:

- `delete` (Number) Indicates a pending delete request if present and not 0.
- `key` (String) Configuration option name.
- `pending` (String) The new pending value.
- `value` (String) Value as it was used to generate the current cloudinit image.


<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Read-Only:

- `acpi` (Boolean) Enable/disable ACPI.
- `affinity` (String) List of host cores used to execute guest processes, for example: 0,5,8-11
- `agent` (String) Enable/disable communication with the QEMU Guest Agent and its properties.
- `allow_ksm` (Boolean) Allow memory pages of this guest to be merged via KSM (Kernel Samepage Merging).
- `amd_sev` (String) Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) features by AMD CPUs
- `arch` (String) Virtual processor architecture. Defaults to the host architecture.
- `args` (String) Arbitrary arguments passed to kvm.
- `audio0` (String) Configure a audio device, useful in combination with QXL/Spice.
- `autostart` (Boolean) Automatic restart after crash (currently ignored).
- `balloon` (Number) Amount of target RAM for the VM in MiB. The balloon driver is enabled by default, unless it is explicitly disabled by setting the value to zero.
- `bios` (String) Select BIOS implementation.
- `boot` (String) Specify guest boot order. Use the 'order=' sub-property as usage with no key or 'legacy=' is deprecated.
- `bootdisk` (String) Enable booting from specified disk. Deprecated: Use 'boot: order=foo;bar' instead.
- `cdrom` (String) This is an alias for option -ide2
- `cicustom` (String) cloud-init: Specify custom files to replace the automatically generated ones at start.
- `cipassword` (String) cloud-init: Password to assign the user. Using this is generally not recommended. Use ssh keys instead. Also note that older cloud-init versions do not support hashed passwords.
- `citype` (String) Specifies the cloud-init configuration format. The default depends on the configured operating system type (`ostype`. We use the `nocloud` format for Linux, and `configdrive2` for windows.
- `ciupgrade` (Boolean) cloud-init: do an automatic package upgrade after the first boot.
- `ciuser` (String) cloud-init: User name to change ssh keys and password for instead of the image's configured default user.
- `cores` (Number) The number of cores per socket.
- `cpu` (String) Emulated CPU type.
- `cpulimit` (Number) Limit of CPU usage.
- `cpuunits` (Number) CPU weight for a VM, will be clamped to [1, 10000] in cgroup v2.
- `description` (String) Description for the VM. Shown in the web-interface VM's summary. This is saved as comment inside the configuration file.
- `digest` (String) SHA1 digest of configuration file. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.
- `efidisk0` (String) Configure a disk for storing EFI vars.
- `freeze` (Boolean) Freeze CPU at startup (use 'c' monitor command to start execution).
- `hookscript` (String) Script that will be executed during various steps in the vms lifetime.
- `hostpci_n_` (String) Map host PCI devices into guest.
- `hotplug` (String) Selectively enable hotplug features. This is a comma separated list of hotplug features: 'network', 'disk', 'cpu', 'memory', 'usb' and 'cloudinit'. Use '0' to disable hotplug completely. Using '1' as value is an alias for the default `network,disk,usb`. USB hotplugging is possible for guests with machine version >= 7.1 and ostype l26 or windows > 7.
- `hugepages` (String) Enables hugepages memory.

Sets the size of hugepages in MiB. If the value is set to 'any' then 1 GiB hugepages will be used if possible, otherwise the size will fall back to 2 MiB.
- `ide_n_` (String) Use volume as IDE hard disk or CD-ROM (n is 0 to 3).
- `intel_tdx` (String) Trusted Domain Extension (TDX) features by Intel CPUs
- `ipconfig_n_` (String) cloud-init: Specify IP addresses and gateways for the corresponding interface.

IP addresses use CIDR notation, gateways are optional but need an IP of the same type specified.

The special string 'dhcp' can be used for IP addresses to use DHCP, in which case no explicit
gateway should be provided.
For IPv6 the special string 'auto' can be used to use stateless autoconfiguration. This requires
cloud-init 19.4 or newer.

If cloud-init is enabled and neither an IPv4 nor an IPv6 address is specified, it defaults to using
dhcp on IPv4.
- `ivshmem` (String) Inter-VM shared memory. Useful for direct communication between VMs, or to the host.
- `keephugepages` (Boolean) Use together with hugepages. If enabled, hugepages will not not be deleted after VM shutdown and can be used for subsequent starts.
- `keyboard` (String) Keyboard layout for VNC server. This option is generally not required and is often better handled from within the guest OS.
- `kvm` (Boolean) Enable/disable KVM hardware virtualization.
- `localtime` (Boolean) Set the real time clock (RTC) to local time. This is enabled by default if the `ostype` indicates a Microsoft Windows OS.
- `lock` (String) Lock/unlock the VM.
- `machine` (String) Specify the QEMU machine.
- `memory` (String) Memory properties.
- `meta` (String) Some (read-only) meta-information about this guest.
- `migrate_downtime` (Number) Set maximum tolerated downtime (in seconds) for migrations. Should the migration not be able to converge in the very end, because too much newly dirtied RAM needs to be transferred, the limit will be increased automatically step-by-step until migration can converge. Will be capped to 2000 seconds (maximum in QEMU).
- `migrate_speed` (Number) Set maximum speed (in MB/s) for migrations. Value 0 is no limit.
- `name` (String) Set a name for the VM. Only used on the configuration web interface.
- `nameserver` (String) cloud-init: Sets DNS server IP address for a container. Create will automatically use the setting from the host if neither searchdomain nor nameserver are set.
- `net_n_` (String) Specify network devices.
- `numa` (Boolean) Enable/disable NUMA.
- `numa_n_` (String) NUMA topology.
- `onboot` (Boolean) Specifies whether a VM will be started during system bootup.
- `ostype` (String) Specify guest operating system.
- `parallel_n_` (String) Map host parallel devices (n is 0 to 2).
- `parent` (String) Parent snapshot name. This is used internally, and should not be modified.
- `protection` (Boolean) Sets the protection flag of the VM. This will disable the remove VM and remove disk operations.
- `reboot` (Boolean) Allow reboot. If set to '0' the VM exit on reboot.
- `rng0` (String) Configure a VirtIO-based Random Number Generator.
- `running_nets_host_mtu` (String) List of VirtIO network devices and their effective host_mtu setting. A value of 0 means that the host_mtu parameter is to be avoided for the corresponding device. This is used internally for snapshots.
- `runningcpu` (String) Specifies the QEMU '-cpu' parameter of the running vm. This is used internally for snapshots.
- `runningmachine` (String) Specifies the QEMU machine type of the running vm. This is used internally for snapshots.
- `sata_n_` (String) Use volume as SATA hard disk or CD-ROM (n is 0 to 5).
- `scsi_n_` (String) Use volume as SCSI hard disk or CD-ROM (n is 0 to 30).
- `scsihw` (String) SCSI controller model
- `searchdomain` (String) cloud-init: Sets DNS search domains for a container. Create will automatically use the setting from the host if neither searchdomain nor nameserver are set.
- `serial_n_` (String) Create a serial device inside the VM (n is 0 to 3)
- `shares` (Number) Amount of memory shares for auto-ballooning. The larger the number is, the more memory this VM gets. Number is relative to weights of all other running VMs. Using zero disables auto-ballooning. Auto-ballooning is done by pvestatd.
- `smbios1` (String) Specify SMBIOS type 1 fields.
- `smp` (Number) The number of CPUs. Please use option -sockets instead.
- `snaptime` (Number) Timestamp for snapshots.
- `sockets` (Number) The number of CPU sockets.
- `spice_enhancements` (String) Configure additional enhancements for SPICE.
- `sshkeys` (String) cloud-init: Setup public SSH keys (one key per line, OpenSSH format).
- `startdate` (String) Set the initial date of the real time clock. Valid format for date are:'now' or '2006-06-17T16:01:21' or '2006-06-17'.
- `startup` (String) Startup and shutdown behavior. Order is a non-negative number defining the general startup order. Shutdown in done with reverse ordering. Additionally you can set the 'up' or 'down' delay in seconds, which specifies a delay to wait before the next VM is started or stopped.
- `tablet` (Boolean) Enable/disable the USB tablet device.
- `tags` (String) Tags of the VM. This is only meta information.
- `tdf` (Boolean) Enable/disable time drift fix.
- `template` (Boolean) Enable/disable Template.
- `tpmstate0` (String) Configure a Disk for storing TPM state. The format is fixed to 'raw'.
- `unused_n_` (String) Reference to unused volumes. This is used internally, and should not be modified manually.
- `usb_n_` (String) Configure an USB device (n is 0 to 4, for machine version >= 7.1 and ostype l26 or windows > 7, n can be up to 14).
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of hotplugged vcpus.
- `vga` (String) Configure the VGA hardware.
- `virtio_n_` (String) Use volume as VIRTIO hard disk (n is 0 to 15).
- `virtiofs_n_` (String) Configuration for sharing a directory between host and guest using Virtio-fs.
- `vmgenid` (String) Set VM Generation ID. Use '1' to autogenerate on create or update, pass '0' to disable explicitly.
- `vmstate` (String) Reference to a volume which stores the VM state. This is used internally for snapshots.
- `vmstatestorage` (String) Default storage for VM state volumes/files.
- `watchdog` (String) Create a virtual hardware watchdog device.


<a id="nestedatt--current"></a>
### Nested Schema for `current`

Read-Only:

- `agent` (Boolean) QEMU Guest Agent is enabled in config.
- `clipboard` (String) Enable a specific clipboard. If not set, depending on the display type the SPICE one will be added.
- `cpu` (Number) Current CPU usage.
- `cpus` (Number) Maximum usable CPUs.
- `diskread` (Number) The amount of bytes the guest read from it's block devices since the guest was started. (Note: This info is not available for all storage types.)
- `diskwrite` (Number) The amount of bytes the guest wrote from it's block devices since the guest was started. (Note: This info is not available for all storage types.)
- `ha` (Attributes) HA manager service status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current--ha))
- `lock` (String) The current config lock, if any.
- `maxdisk` (Number) Root disk size in bytes.
- `maxmem` (Number) Maximum memory in bytes.
- `mem` (Number) Currently used memory in bytes. Does not take into account kernel same-page merging (KSM). Uses information from ballooning when available.
- `memhost` (Number) Current memory usage on the host. Does not take into account kernel same-page merging (KSM).
- `name` (String) VM (host)name.
- `netin` (Number) The amount of traffic in bytes that was sent to the guest over the network since it was started.
- `netout` (Number) The amount of traffic in bytes that was sent from the guest over the network since it was started.
- `pid` (Number) PID of the QEMU process, if the VM is running.
- `pressurecpufull` (Number) CPU Full pressure stall average over the last 10 seconds.
- `pressurecpusome` (Number) CPU Some pressure stall average over the last 10 seconds.
- `pressureiofull` (Number) IO Full pressure stall average over the last 10 seconds.
- `pressureiosome` (Number) IO Some pressure stall average over the last 10 seconds.
- `pressurememoryfull` (Number) Memory Full pressure stall average over the last 10 seconds.
- `pressurememorysome` (Number) Memory Some pressure stall average over the last 10 seconds.
- `qmpstatus` (String) VM run state from the 'query-status' QMP monitor command.
- `running_machine` (String) The currently running machine type (if running).
- `running_qemu` (String) The QEMU version the VM is currently using (if running).
- `serial` (Boolean) Guest has serial device configured.
- `spice` (Boolean) QEMU VGA configuration supports spice.
- `status` (String) QEMU process status.
- `tags` (String) The current configured tags, if any
- `template` (Boolean) Determines if the guest is a template.
- `uptime` (Number) Uptime in seconds.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.
